structured.answer: I'd pick "כספי (שקלי)", because it shows 0% shares and 0% foreign currency, it's in shekels like my deposit, and it shows 4.25% over 3 years for about the same fee as the others. Before I sign I'd ask my son or Harel what it really is.

stuck.why: Many buttons with English (S&P 500) and 'עוקב מדד', and I didn't know which ones are safe
I wanted bonds, but where the return should be it only says 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so I couldn't compare
Not sure if 4.25% is per year or for all 3 years, or what 'לפני דמי ניהול' means
